title: mairia crenata
intro: Mairia crenata, commonly known as the Creeping Mairia or Mairia plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Compositae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Mairia crenata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The plant's bioactive constituents are thought to contribute to its potential health benefits, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
